text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High tail latency detected for tenant fin-sight-prod on us-west-2 (p99 token latency > 3s) — auto-escalate to oncall

Samir (oncall): got it, I'm oncall. pulling dashboards now.

Maya N.: seeing p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~3.8s for streaming responses; non-stream endpoints look OK. Streaming gaps: >2s between chunks.

Eli R.: tagging in. any deploys in the last hour?

Samir (oncall): no deploys in last 2h per deploy-bot. concurrency for that tenant jumped from 4->18 around 17:12 UTC per request-rate graph.

Tasha (eng-sre): interesting — looks like a burst of long prompts from the customer. seq len distribution shifted to >1.5k tokens. KV cache misses spiked.

Jordan (CSM): I've already got a thread with FinSight asking about slower streaming for a few requests, they reported intermittent stalls. They're on Dedicated but routed through the shared streaming proxy layer.

Samir (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) throttle tenant to reduce concurrency; 2) switch tenant to non-streaming (buffered) path; 3) route to a smaller model variant; 4) enable aggressive batching/capacity isolate. Which should we try first?

Eli R.: do 1 + 2: throttle to concurrency=3, flip to non-streaming fallback. We can do routing change at the edge quickly.

Maya N.: creating a temporary route now:
```json
PATCH /v1/routing/tenants/fin-sight-prod
{ "streaming_enabled": false, "max_concurrency": 3 }
```

incident-bot: action scheduled by Samir: route change queued (runbook-confirmed) — apply in 30s window.

Samir (oncall): applied. confirming metrics...

Maya N.: p95 dropped to 0.9s, p99 down to 1.5s within 2 minutes. Streaming stalls gone on the buffered path. FinSight reports fewer complaints.

Tasha (eng-sre): digging into root cause: trace sampling shows large KV cache churn; some long-running inference tasks blocked on disk-backed KV eviction on nodes serving that tenant. Looks like a combination of long prompt patterns + concurrent sessions hitting the same model shards.

Eli R.: node logs snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-01-23T17:13:02Z WARN stall_detected tenant=fin-sight-prod stalled_seq=1245 stall_duration_ms=2100 shard=3
2026-01-23T17:13:03Z ERROR evict_to_disk tenant=fin-sight-prod cache_pressure=0.92
```

Jordan (CSM): Customer impact summary for support: ~120 requests impacted in 30m window, degraded streaming UX. No request errors, just delayed chunks. Customer facing note in 30m?

Samir (oncall): agree. Jordan can send an interim note: "We're investigating intermittent streaming stalls affecting chunked delivery; temporary mitigation in place. We will follow up with RCA."

Jordan (CSM): will draft and send in 15.

Tasha (eng-sre): long-term mitigations proposed: per-tenant KV cache isolation (prevent eviction cascades), model-routing by prompt-length heuristics, and backpressure at proxy to avoid hot-shard concurrency. Also add a streaming stall detector metric to trigger autoscaling earlier.

Eli R.: quick follow-up action items for oncall handoff:
- collect flamegraph + kv cache metrics for last 1h (cmd below)
- upload sample prompts (anonymized) that caused stalls
- correlate tenant concurrency spikes with client ids

Commands:
```
curl -sS "https://observability.internal/api/query?metric=kv_cache_pressure&tenant=fin-sight-prod&from=17:00&to=17:30" > fin_kv.json
rdctl traces query --tenant fin-sight-prod --since 1h > fin_traces.json
```

Samir (oncall): I'm going to compile those and attach to this thread. handoff in 30m: Eli will be primary.

incident-bot: oncall handoff reminder — Samir (oncall) will hand off to Eli R. at 1801025256.

Maya N.: uploaded fin_traces.json (redacted) and sample_prompts.txt to incident artifacts: https://internal.artifacts/1801023456

Eli R.: grabbing artifacts now. preliminary observation: ~70% of impacted requests used a single very long system prompt pattern (multi-document summarization). Bucketizing prompts shows cluster with heavy attention reuse causing KV thrash.

Tasha (eng-sre): Proposed short-term infra change: reserve an extra shard for high-memory KV cache for tenant fin-sight-prod to avoid eviction for 2h window. Ops, can we spin that up?

Samir (oncall): ops-rotation-bot, please request a temporary shard spin with tag fin-sight-kv-hot for 2h.

ops-rotation-bot: Request submitted to infra pipeline (ticket INF-4523). ETA 7 minutes.

Maya N.: infra report: shard allocated and rebalanced at 17:26 UTC. p99 token latency with buffered path stable at ~1.1s after allocation.

Jordan (CSM): FinSight acknowledges mitigation and appreciates rapid response. They want an RCA and timeline for a more permanent fix.

Samir (oncall): good. log final mitigation steps here and add RCA owner.

Eli R.: RCA owner: Tasha. Draft RCA due EOD tomorrow. Action items:
- Tasha: RCA + proposed infra changes (KV isolation, shard reservation rules)
- Maya: add prompt-length routing rule templating and docs
- Samir: follow up with product on per-tenant quotas and streaming fallbacks
- Jordan: customer communication and timeline

Tasha (eng-sre): noted. I'll include perf benchmarks for the isolation approach.

Samir (oncall): closing pager for now — mitigations stable, customer notified. Leaving thread open for RCA work.

incident-bot: Pager closed by Samir at 1801024200.

Eli R.: leaving handoff notes for next oncall:
- watch p99 token latency for fin-sight-prod over next 12h
- ensure INF-4523 completes tear-down at TTL (2h) unless RCA dictates otherwise
- if p99 rises >2.5s, escalate to eng-sre and trigger shard-reserve fallback

Jordan (CSM): Sent interim customer note at 17:40 UTC. Will follow up with RCA when available. :thumbsup:

Tasha (eng-sre): adding to monday postmortem agenda: prompt patterns that trigger KV thrash and product-level mitigations.

Samir (oncall): thanks team. handing to Eli.

Eli R.: taking over. I'll post updates as we get RCA drafts.
